## If this is a map

Made with the map maker at `editor/`, which is the easiest way to get the file right.

- [ ] **Check** in the map maker says *"This is a place"* — no squares walled off, a start you can
      stand on, and every tile really in the sheet
- [ ] The file is in `data/maps/` and its name is lower case with dashes, like `the-old-well.json`
- [ ] I looked at it in the map maker after saving, and it is the map I meant

Say a sentence about the place: what is it, and what is it for?

## If this is code

- [ ] I opened the game and used the thing I changed
- [ ] The test pages in `tests/` still show all PASS (`rules`, `net`, `spectate`, `wins`, `map`)
- [ ] If I changed a file the game loads, I bumped `CACHE` in `sw.js` — otherwise the fix ships and
      nobody ever receives it
